categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/net_processing.cpp` by splitting `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage()` into separate message handlers.
categories.rationale: Decomposes the monolithic 1,000-line `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage()` into per-message helper functions. While it improves readability and scoping in `net_processing.cpp`, it is a move-only refactoring that does not retire an active hazard, improve protocol performance, or fix bugs.
